title: 第一卷 第5章 镇中怪事第一卷 第6章 大寿
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 今日的阳光本就明媚，王管家却冷得瑟瑟发抖，连腿脚都站不稳。
远处，本就看热闹的邻居迅速将大门紧闭，生怕一有不对，惹得麻烦上身。
门户内同时传来长吁短叹，
“你说这林老爷子也真是的，都七十高寿了，还学人娶妻，娶妻就算了，居然跟寒少抢人？”
“要我说啊，这就是老寿星上吊——找死，寒少向来霸道，谁得罪得起？”
“刚虎爷这一脚是内劲吧？果然是先天武师！”
“哎，可惜了这么好的人，前两日乔迁来，还给各户送了薄礼。”
“谁说不是呢？这虎爷可是活阎王，横行霸道惯了，看上的东西谁敢不给？这日子什么时候是个头哟。”
“行了，还是少说点吧，若被听去可就要倒大霉了。”
陈虎眯着眼打量白发老者，他是志在必得。
寒少离开前交代过，先给林老头一个教训，再把杨芸带回去。
可他略一打听后，发现老头还挺有钱。
这不巧了么？
林寻饶有兴趣的打量一眼地面，这就是先天，用内劲能把石板踩碎？
可惜了，终究是凡俗武道，上不得台面。
“老夫若是不给呢？”林寻斜视一眼，根本没放在心上。
“老头，你是敬酒不吃吃罚酒是吧？”陈虎狞笑一声，伸上向林寻抓去。
可下一刻，就见一个巴掌在眼前放大，根本来不及闪躲，就甩在脸上！
这声脆响，远超方才十倍。
在众人惊恐的目光中，陈虎壮硕的身躯就横飞了出去。
他撞翻身后的数人后余势不减，又在地上弹了两下，撞到对面的台阶才停下来。
左半边脸更是完全变形，牙齿也滚落一地，人如死狗般昏了过去。
全场死寂！
家奴们的脸色煞白！
先天武师.......就这么被一巴掌扇飞了？
林寻收回手掌，轻飘飘道：“老夫好心，今日就留他一命。
回去告诉你们主子，再派人来，就不是一巴掌的事了。
家奴们闻言才敢动弹，慌张的抬起陈虎逃去。
王管家张了张嘴，想说什么，却没再多言。
他也没想到，老爷能这么厉害，一巴掌就降伏了陈虎。
最差也是先天武师！
可很快，他的眉头锁的更紧，自家老爷岁数大了，这样的出手能有几次？
寒家可不止一位先天武师啊！
content_en:
The sun was shining brightly today, but Butler Wang was so cold that he shivered and couldn't even stand steady on his legs.
In the distance, neighbors who were watching the excitement quickly closed the door tightly, fearing that if something went wrong, they would get into trouble.
Long sighs and short sighs came from the door at the same time,
"You think it's true that Mr. Lin is already seventy years old. He's still learning how to marry a wife. He just wants to marry a wife, but he actually steals a wife from Young Master Han?"
"If you ask me, this is the old birthday girl hanging himself - seeking death. Young Master Han has always been domineering, who can afford to offend him?"
"Isn't Master Ganghu's kick an internal force? He is indeed an innate martial artist!"
"Hey, it's a pity that such a good person moved in two days ago and gave each household small gifts."
"Who says it's not the case? This Lord Tiger is a living king of hell. He is used to being domineering and domineering. Who dares not to give him what he likes? When will this day end?"
"Okay, let's talk less. It will be bad luck if you are listened to."
"Yes, be careful what you say, be careful what you say..."
Chen Hu squinted his eyes and looked at the white-haired old man. He was determined to win.
Before leaving, Mr. Han promised to teach Old Man Lin a lesson before taking Yang Yun back.
But after making some inquiries, he found that the old man was quite rich.
Isn't this a coincidence?
Lin Xun looked at the ground with interest. This is innateness. Can he crush stone slabs with his inner strength?
It's a pity, after all, it's ordinary martial arts and can't be put on the stage.
"What if I don't give it to you?" Lin Xun squinted and didn't take it to heart at all.
"Old man, you're going to have to drink wine as a penalty if you don't eat the toast, right?" Chen Hu laughed evilly and reached out to grab Lin Xun.
But the next moment, I saw a slap magnified in front of my eyes, and I didn't even have time to dodge, and it was slapped on my face!
Snap——! ! !
This crisp sound was far ten times louder than before.
In the horrified eyes of everyone, Chen Hu's strong body flew out.
After knocking over several people behind him, he still managed to survive. He bounced on the ground twice more and finally stopped when he hit the steps on the opposite side.
The left half of his face was completely deformed, his teeth fell to the ground, and he fainted like a dead dog.
The whole place was dead silent!
The faces of the domestic slaves turned pale!
The innate martial artist... was just slapped away?
Lin Xun retracted his palm and said lightly: "I am kind-hearted and will spare his life today.
Go back and tell your master that if you send someone again, it won't be a slap in the face.
Get out! "
The slaves didn't dare to move until they heard this, and they picked up Chen Hu in a panic and ran away.
Butler Wang opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but said no more.
He also didn't expect that the master could be so powerful and subdued Chen Hu with just one slap.
The worst is also an innate martial artist!
But soon, his brows furrowed even more tightly. My master is getting older, how many times can he do this?
The Han family has more than one innate martial artist!
